subject: obstetrics-gynaecology
title: Postpartum Blues, Depression, Psychosis and Sheehan Syndrome

steps.tx: Tearfulness, irritability and lability peaking at day four or five in most mothers are the **postpartum blues**. Hormonal withdrawal and sleep deprivation drive them. They resolve within two weeks without treatment beyond support and reassurance from family and staff. Blues affect 50 to 80 percent of mothers and need no drug treatment.
steps.say: Postpartum blues peak at day four and resolve within two weeks with support.

steps.tx: Persistent low mood, anhedonia and impaired functioning in the first year is **postpartum depression**. It affects about one in seven mothers and impairs bonding and infant development. Validated questionnaires screen for it at postnatal contacts in most services. Edinburgh scale scores of 13 or more flag probable depression needing full assessment.
steps.say: Postpartum depression affects one in seven mothers and impairs bonding.

steps.tx: A psychiatric emergency with delusions, mania and disorganisation in the first fortnight is **puerperal psychosis**. Risk concentrates in bipolar disorder and previous puerperal episodes. Mother and baby unit admission keeps them together under close supervision. Psychosis strikes about one to two per thousand births, usually within the first two weeks.
steps.say: Puerperal psychosis is an emergency needing mother and baby unit admission.

steps.tx: Pituitary necrosis after severe postpartum haemorrhage causing failure to lactate and amenorrhoea is **Sheehan syndrome**. The enlarged pregnant pituitary outgrows its blood supply during shock. Hormone replacement is lifelong once the diagnosis is established. Failure to lactate in a woman who planned to breastfeed is often the first clue after a big haemorrhage.
steps.say: Sheehan syndrome necroses the pituitary after haemorrhage, failing lactation first.

steps.tx: The thyroid keeps its own calendar after delivery. **Postpartum thyroiditis** runs a thyrotoxic phase from gland destruction, then often a hypothyroid phase, within the first year, and it is easily mistaken for depression or ordinary new mother exhaustion. Antibody positive women and those with type 1 diabetes carry the risk. A thyroid function test belongs in persistent postpartum fatigue before symptoms are assigned to mood alone.
steps.say: Postpartum thyroiditis swings through toxic then hypothyroid phases in the first year after birth. Persistent fatigue deserves a thyroid test before a mood label.

vis.caption: A timeline shows thyroid hormone rising then falling across the first postpartum year. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Autoimmune thyroid dysfunction within a year of delivery, often missed as normal fatigue, is **postpartum thyroiditis**. Its hypothyroid phase needs levothyroxine when symptomatic or planning pregnancy. A third develop permanent hypothyroidism in later years. About a third settle permanently hypothyroid, so annual thyroid checks continue after recovery.
steps.say: Postpartum thyroiditis is missed as fatigue and a third become permanently hypothyroid.

steps.tx: Thrombosis risk peaks in the first three weeks after delivery, mandating **deep vein thrombosis** vigilance. Risk assessment before discharge assigns prophylaxis by caesarean, obesity and thrombophilia. Leg pain or breathlessness earns same day assessment without delay. The first six weeks carry the risk, peaking around days seven to twenty one after birth.
steps.say: Deep vein thrombosis risk peaks in the first three postpartum weeks.

steps.tx: Suicide is a leading cause of late maternal death, making **mental health enquiry** mandatory at every contact. Asking directly does not plant ideas and opens disclosure. Known bipolar or previous psychosis earns a written perinatal mental health plan. Red flag thoughts of harming the baby bypass routine referral queues and go to crisis services the same day.
steps.say: Mental health enquiry is mandatory because suicide leads late maternal deaths.

vis.alt: Perinatal mental health enquiry at a postnatal contact asking directly about mood, psychosis risk and safety
vis.caption: Perinatal mental health enquiry at a postnatal contact asking directly about mood, psychosis risk and safety. Illustration: StewardMD original.

steps.tx: Contraception counselling before discharge prevents short interval pregnancies, termed **postpartum contraception planning**. Long acting methods placed immediately have the highest continuation rates. Ovulation can precede the first period, even while breastfeeding partially. Lactational amenorrhoea protects only when feeding is exclusive, frequent and the baby is under six months.
steps.say: Postpartum contraception planning uses immediate long acting methods for continuation.

steps.tx: Hair shedding, night sweats and lochia changes frighten uninformed mothers, covered by **normal puerperium counselling**. Forewarning converts panic calls into reassurance. Written discharge information lists true danger signs separately and clearly. Telogen effluvium hair loss peaks at three to four months and regrows by a year in most women.
steps.say: Normal puerperium counselling forewarns about hair shedding and night sweats.
